These contradictions make independent completion decisions ambiguous or require successor evidence. findings.finding: In specs/ci-model-modernization/tasks.md, reconcile completion criteria with acceptance-tests.md and Test Ownership: T-005's first Done When item requires assigned TEST-116, whose acceptance assertion is a real installed Codex invocation, but its fourth item excludes installed-entry proof until dependent T-006. T-007's first item specifies AC-017 / TEST-112 through TEST-116 instead of AC-017's TEST-111 through TEST-115, importing T-005's installed-host criterion. T-008's first item claims assigned TEST-128, which is AC-020 documentation owned by dependent T-009, rather than its owned TEST-127 native-proof distinction. These are blocking completion-contract inconsistencies: a quality evaluator cannot apply the stated task boundaries and acceptance references simultaneously without choosing which instruction to disregard. Align identifiers and ownership, and place installed-entry acceptance with the task that supplies that evidence.
